description: Submits a request to the Barmaan team for a catalog service (kind service, needs family), a custom service, or a software project. Contact name, e-mail and phone come from your profile (a phone number must be saved there). Files cannot be attached here; add them on the website. Call without confirm first for a preview, show it to the user, then again with confirm:true and the preview_token. Retrying the same call does not create a duplicate.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

details.description: Only keys listed in extra_fields of the family.

family.description: Required for kind service. See request_catalog_get.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

service.description: Service slug from request_catalog_get, or 'other' / omitted.

project_type.description: company-website, online-store, booking-platform, business-software, mobile-app, improve-existing, ai-automation, corporate-email, consultation or other.

name: request_create
title: Submit a service request
